searchText: Did you open a PR for this <@755590043632140352> , I made the tests pass in Teku, but not in love with the implementation A PR for what? reverting the changes on withdrawals? Justin already did For the proposer boost changes I mean PR in Prysm oh you mean if I added this to Prysm? no I didn't. I do not plan on adding this anytime soon So you just ignore the failing minimal tests? I don't think this is easy so I'll wait until I'm dealing with that in Gloas. Yeah, we're ignoring those specific tests with long reorgs that fail. Also implementing this will break a million unit tests on Prysm designed specifically to deal with long reorgs. Not happy about that one either 🙂 I was looking at graffiti watermarks again if anyone interested... ``` Slots: 1225121 Without watermarks: 72.28% (885492) including watermarks: 27.72% (339629) CL CLients found: LH 52.41% (178016) LS 2.44% (8296) TK 45.14% (153317) EL Clients found: GE 47.14% (160088) RH 2.21% (7513) BU 16.49% (56011) EG 0.16% (548) NM 34.00% (115469) ``` I'm just running on a minimal node, and the included rate is fairly low, but given i generated it i'll share. It's fairly low quality data given the included rate and clear bias towards a small number defaulting watermarking to on.
